title: Question 24
text: A, B, and C are partners sharing profits in the ratio of 5:3:2. Their Balance Sheet as on 31st March 2025 is as follows: Capital - A: ₹ 2,00,000, B: ₹ 1,50,000, C: ₹ 1,00,000; Reserve: ₹ 50,000; Creditors: ₹ 80,000; Assets - Land & Building: ₹ 2,50,000, Machinery: ₹ 1,50,000, Stock: ₹ 80,000, Debtors: ₹ 70,000, Cash: ₹ 30,000. They admit D for 1/5th share in profits on the following terms:
bullets: D brings ₹ 1,00,000 as capital and ₹ 40,000 for goodwill
Land & Building to be appreciated by 20%
Provision for doubtful debts @ 5% to be created
Unrecorded liability of ₹ 10,000 to be brought into books

Z is to be paid ₹ 20,000 immediately and the balance in 3 equal annual instalments with interest @ 10% p.a. Pass necessary journal entries and prepare Z's Loan Account till final payment.

Excess money received on application was adjusted towards allotment. Ram, who applied for 1,200 shares, failed to pay allotment and call money. His shares were forfeited after first call.
